title: Parking beneath Group R.
officialText:
Where a maximum one-story above grade plane Group S-2 parking garage, enclosed or open, or
combination thereof, of Type I construction or open of Type IV construction, with grade entrance, is provided under a building of
Group R, the number of stories to be used in determining the minimum type of construction shall be measured from the floor above
such a parking area. The horizontal floor assembly between the parking garage and the Group R above shall comply with the type of
construction required for the parking garage and shall also provide a fire-resistance rating not less than the mixed occupancy separa-
tion required in Section 508.4.
